permission.reference: https://api.adsb.lol/api/openapi.json (read 2026-11-10): free API, data under ODbL 1.0; the maintainer asks to be contacted before production use; responses advertise a 500 requests/day limit (x-ratelimit headers, observed 2026-11-11). Approved for local research display only: anonymous en-route positions, military/PIA/LADD excluded, no redistribution.

https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data: public EDGAR data; fair access at most 10 requests/second with a declared User-Agent. Approved for local research display of the latest Form 4 filings; responses are journaled.
